description: Update one or more JRD settings. Pass a partial JSON object — only the fields you include are changed (e.g. `{ "fps_limit": 60, "quality": "high" }`). The server merges your patch into the live settings, persists to disk, and returns the merged result. Note: `start_with_system` is intentionally ignored over MCP to avoid surprising autostart side effects.

patch.description: Subset of AppSettings fields to update. Use jrd_get_settings first to see all available keys.

name: jrd_set_settings
